summary.headline: Treya Partners secures $412K in annual savings for SaVida Health with $358K already locked in
summary.narrative: Since launching in October 2024, Treya Partners has driven meaningful sourcing activity across five spend areas for SaVida Health. The engagement has finalized $357,889 in annual savings through an Athena EMR contract renegotiation and has unlocked a further $54,176 in validated or actively-negotiated savings from GPO, IT hardware, and telecom initiatives. Key wins include cutting EMR fees by 1.16 percentage points and moving SaVida onto a Provista GPO contract for medical and office supplies. Additional run-rate savings will be realized as the telecom consolidation and hardware strategy are completed.
